name: Uniform latent range noise (city96)
plain: Fills a latent with uniform random values scaled between measured per-channel limits for SD1 or SDXL. It is not Gaussian despite the function name. An optional shared random field across channels makes colored blotches go monochrome.
math:
r ~ U(0,1) (shared across channels, or one per channel).
lat_c = min_c + r·(max_c−min_c). out = ((lat·fac)·(1−nul) + nul_c·nul)/2.
label: from code
surprise: Function and node are named Gaussian, but the draw is torch.rand uniform with hardcoded ranges like −22 to 33, far from unit variance.
